name: Compound Person Name (NER)
description: Catches multi-word first_name or last_name spans that personal.first_name_ner and personal.last_name_ner reject via single_word validation. Handles model misclassification where a full person name (e.g. 'Jordan Reese') is tagged as a single last_name or first_name entity. Replaced with [PERSON]. Rule ID sorts alphabetically after personal.first_name_ner and personal.last_name_ner so those rules always win tie-breaks on single-word spans.

effect.message: Compound person name detected by NER replaced for de-identification
